name: Transmogrifier CLI
description: Click-based command-line interface for the Transmogrifier library. Provides commands for register detection, task classification, prompt translation, and model profile management (list, show, calibrate).

functions.name: main
functions.description: Click command group entry point for Transmogrifier CLI. Provides top-level commands for register-aware prompt translation.
postconditions: Click group is configured with subcommands: detect, classify, translate, profile

structured_side_effects.description: Creates Click command group with subcommands

functions.name: detect
functions.description: Detects the register of input text and outputs JSON with register value and confidence score.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Input text to analyze for register detection

postconditions: JSON output written to stdout with keys 'register' and 'confidence'
side_effects: Writes JSON to stdout via click.echo

structured_side_effects.description: Outputs JSON with register and confidence

functions.name: classify
functions.description: Classifies the task type of input text and outputs JSON with task_type value and confidence score.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Input text to classify for task type

postconditions: JSON output written to stdout with keys 'task_type' and 'confidence'
side_effects: Writes JSON to stdout via click.echo

structured_side_effects.description: Outputs JSON with task_type and confidence

functions.name: translate
functions.description: Translates text to optimal register for target model. Outputs either JSON or formatted text with translation results including detected register, task type, target register, level applied, timing, and transformed output.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Target model name for profile lookup

inputs.name: as_json
inputs.description: Flag to enable JSON output format

error_cases.name: invalid_register
error_cases.condition: target is not None and Register(target) raises ValueError

preconditions: If target is provided, it must be a valid Register value
postconditions: Translation result written to stdout in JSON or formatted text format
side_effects: Writes formatted output or JSON to stdout

structured_side_effects.description: Sets target_register if target parameter is provided
Outputs translation results as JSON or formatted text

functions.name: profile
functions.description: Click command group for managing model register sensitivity profiles. Provides subcommands: list, show, calibrate.
postconditions: Click group is configured with subcommands: list, show, calibrate
side_effects: Registers Click subcommand group under main

structured_side_effects.description: Creates Click subcommand group with profile management commands

functions.name: profile_list
functions.description: Lists all cached model profiles with spread, best register, and per-task breakdowns. Marks invariant profiles.
postconditions: All cached profiles listed to stdout with summary statistics

functions.name: profile_show
functions.description: Shows detailed profile information for a specific model including aggregate accuracies (sorted descending with bar chart) and per-task accuracies. Handles missing profiles gracefully.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Name of the model to show profile for

postconditions: If profile exists, detailed stats are displayed; otherwise, not-found message is shown

structured_side_effects.description: Reads cached profile data for model_name
Outputs detailed profile or not-found message

functions.name: profile_calibrate
functions.description: Runs calibration benchmark for a model across all registers. Creates backend, initializes CalibrationRunner, executes benchmark tasks (full set or reduced quick set of 10), and saves resulting profile to cache. Outputs progress and summary statistics.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Name for the profile being calibrated

inputs.name: model_id
inputs.description: API model ID if different from profile name

inputs.name: quick
inputs.description: Flag to run reduced task set (10 tasks instead of full)

error_cases.name: backend_creation_failure
error_cases.condition: create_backend() raises exception (invalid provider or credentials)

error_cases.name: calibration_failure
error_cases.condition: runner.run() raises exception during benchmark execution

preconditions: provider is a valid backend provider
API credentials are configured for the provider
postconditions: Calibration profile is saved to cache
Summary statistics (spread, best register) are displayed
side_effects: Creates backend, cache, and runner instances
Writes progress and results to stdout

structured_side_effects.description: Makes 5 * len(tasks) API calls for calibration

invariants: CLI requires click library; exits with code 1 if not available
All commands output to stdout via click.echo
JSON outputs use standard json.dumps with appropriate formatting
Profile commands lazy-import dependencies to avoid import overhead
Quick calibration mode uses exactly 10 tasks from BENCHMARK_TASKS
Full calibration makes 5 API calls per task (one per register)

data_access.rationale: CLI reads user input via Click decorators, reads cached profile data for profile commands, writes all output to stdout, and persists calibration results to profile cache.

side_effects.rationale: profile_calibrate makes multiple API calls to model providers for calibration benchmarks
profile_calibrate saves calibration results to ProfileCache storage

authority.rationale: This module owns the command-line interface layer, user interaction patterns, and orchestration of calibration workflows. It delegates core translation logic to src.transmogrifier.core and profile management to src.transmogrifier.profiles.
